notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn Final Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]

This game has been an astronomical pain in the ass. It's just not cooperative with any and most changes I've made to it and it's gone through a lot of hardship, bugs and issues. Unfortunately, due to some incompatibility of the plugins and the program itself. Some changes JUST don't want to work with me. It's not that I haven't fixed the issue or checked 10-20 times. It's that when I do fix the issue, the program outwardly fails to acknowledge that anything has in fact changed. So nothing does.

So for a big issue that takes place in chapter 4. The fix is this:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/67c3268e58d9cdddf0493b8f7f46b07c2bcbbf7d.png[/img]

There is a tall snow tree on the right side of the village of oteskta. Interact with it on the right side, facing left. You can then enter the code; 719. (This should only be used if you get sent back to chapter 3 if you are already on chapter 4). Ignore the tree if you are on chapter 2 and can progress through the village to chapter 3 just fine.

This game has already obtained several silent updates, fixing other issues pertaining to this error and several others.

*There is a glitch that allows Thedo and the gang to teleport to chapter 5 through the school in chapter 2. While you can use this to practically speed run the game. You miss out of a lot of story including character deaths and all the important side quests, unlockables and content. So unless your mission as Thedo is to go to the school. Don't go to the school any earlier than you have to.*

Yes, this issue has been attempted to be fixed several times, yes nothing can be done about it, due to the program.

Unfortunately these issues are here and nothing can be done about them, except working around them.

In other news, Euclyca is a game that needs my full undivided attention and is a lot of work. I'm only one person and this SE II bs is really tearing me down. I wish I could tell you that the fixes I applied multiple times had actually worked. But, they don't. But, just like the first game in the series, no matter what I try to do to fix it, just seems to not want to budge. Gotta say, this program is a hassle and a half sometimes.


Lastly; here is what is new:

-2 doom blasters in the tree.


*I cannot say that this officially counts as an update as it is lackluster in content. But, what I can say is that it now provides a way for everyone to safety beat the game from start to finish. Which is probably one of the most, if not the most important thing to come to any game in an update.

I know it's hard, but if you survived 2020, you can survive this game.

Tomorrow is the last chance to pick up this donation DLC;
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343980/Solenars_Edge_II_Aurora_of_The_Seventh_Dawn_Nelditus_Donation/

If you feel like my continuous hard work is worth rewarding, I won't stop you. Either way, thanks.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]


Welcome to the next update of Solenars Edge v1.2.

only found once in the game. It contains a new spell called;
Alnestia's Blessing.

Adds MP Regen, Mdf and Mat for all allies.
*You need 550 MP and 30 TP to cast it*

He can be found in the end-game resort.

-Extended a certain character's scene in the forrest of memories.

-You can now buy a fishing rod from the school supplier.

-Added in the last outfit for Aionis; Dark Knight Set.
Based off of Scel from Tales of Beasteria.

-Added in six new characters in the end-game arena.

-Orkeida (Last Song/Tutorial).
-Ralna (SER)
-Solen (SER)
-Maribelle (SER)
-Phyrith (SER)
-Felm (Falnarion Tactics).

appearence change vender.

-Outfit/Secret boss added into the guide.

-Added in Leonard's Younger Version in the
appearence change vender.

-Fixed Leafen's skillset to reflect more grass type moves.

-Changed Kilken's weapons to Golem Fist Xs which include his voice SE.

-Added in Zero to the special thanks in the credits.

-Slightly buffed the Glacious weapons.

-Changed Melvin's skillset a bit and buffed him.

-Buffed the skill; Roundhouse Kick.

-Fixed the animation for Flame Strike.

-Buffed Thedo's attack damage and magic attack damage including the weapons he uses.

-Closed off the polls for the character submission forum.

-Fixed some of Atsumora's dialogue.

-Removed the chest on the world map that contained a stylus that
prevented the player from continuing the story on the second return
of the world map.

-Fixed the cutscene at the start in the school where Aionis didn't walk all

looks better this way).

notes.title: The issue with Armeida Tactics
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/5ceefda5daf786f9f09da7f6784cdd1e6beb9573.png[/img]

So, currently, those who have the Armeida Tactics DLC installed are unable to launch anything besides Armeida Tactics. Unfortunately the DLC overwrites the main game's files instead of adding a separate folder inside of them. When you turn off the DLC everything works as intended.

So, with trying to make it work as intended, nothing remotely worked as it was supposed to.

I found a solution that did work however.

I added Armeida Tactics within the game's folder as a seperate folder and the launcher options now work as intended, provided you do not have the DLC installed. The DLC will no longer automatically install for new players. Those who have the DLC installed, should promptly uninstall it for everything to function properly. Again, with the DLC unchecked, you will still be able to play both Solenars Edge II and Armeida Tactics.

Lastly, Armeida Tactics will be removed as DLC and will not be ownable/downloadable in the future.
It will instead be installed within it's own folder within the main game's folder.

When current/new players of Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn, buy/start the game. The game's folder will contain both SEII and Armeida Tactics and will both be launch-able as separate games.

I apologize for this inconvenience and all should work as intended as long as those who own the DLC do NOT enable it.

notes.title: The game doesn't contain a virus.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]

It's really silly how far people are willing to go, but I cannot control that. Anyways, virus protection software is usually very Anti-Gaming and will report multiple false positives. I, for one, do not know how to create a virus and there isn't a file that is claimed to be a virus within the games' files regardless. Either way, this shouldn't be taken seriously as a game wouldn't be released on Steam as they are very anal about their screening process.

To my anti virus, Royal Crown, PSO2 and Tekken 7 contain a virus. But, I can apparently play the games just fine.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1283810/discussions/0/2290590708545231411/
This is the discussion that sparked this post.


Also, the demo *which also doesn't contain a virus and yet contains pretty much the same files as the main game* will be up until June 17th as originally planned. Then it will disappear forever.
*It was taken down by accident while editing the dlcs, etc.*

I'm 100 percent certain that there isn't a virus, you may find a small game bug such as some skill not working as intended, but no virus.


Anyways, I hope you all have a wonderful day and enjoy your time within Solenars Edge II!

notes.title: Solenars Edge Series.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]


Solenars Edge started as a school project back in 2008. It was a short story made on microsoft word  and was lost just a week later, due to the inability of the school allowing me to bring the files with me. Years later, on a walk in the Forrest. I remembered... everything. This time, I wrote it down and nobody could take it from me.

 From then on, I made four small demos. v0.1, v0.2, v0.3, and v0.4. Each of these demos contained one element of the game such as combat or exploration and showcased it promptly. These demos also contained characters from the anime; Fairy Tail. As, at the time, Fairy Tail was one of my favorite shows and not really featured in many games.

 After showing them to some friends at the time and people around me, I decided to work on chapter one. After many months, chapter one was finished and was really hard unfortunately. Most people quit after the first dungeon after being bombarded by mobs and poison.

 So, I as time went by, I tweaked and I tweaked it. I've lost friends along the way, allies, etc. Then I lost the game. Everything got corrupted and for a year I took a break. At this time, I made some side games such as Solenars Edge: Legends and Trials of Almachia. *Both games are discontinued now.*

 I was also thinking about a completely different game called "The Legend of The White Fang." But, it never took flight.  This was back in 2012-2014. I then... started from scratch, all over again on Solenars Edge.  So, I remade chapter one as best as my memory could serve me. At this time, I met this one guy, who was really interested in the game. 

 That's all I needed to continue making it. I released the chapters episodically. Every time a chapter was completed, I sent him a .zip and he would play it. He really enjoyed it and anxiously awaited the next chapter. That was my motivation to make this game. I was new, and I didn't know much, but I was excited to make him something he would enjoy. When I finished the game, I recompiled it into Solenars Edge 2.0 *Which is currently on Itch.io*. This was back in 2015 or so. After all those years, my work was finished. At this time, I also made a side story game called Balthus Requiem. It is a prequel going back many years into a very old character's life and gave more world development.

Then, about one to two years later... I bought greenlight and tried to get it on Steam to a wider audience. It was met with a harsh backlash, hatred I've never seen before. It was different to say the least. Needless to say, Steam Direct came out and my money was wasted. The game was then re-crafted again into Solenars Edge: Rebirth. All the copyrighted content was removed, so it could be distributed on Steam. I'd done it, I finally finished that one game. It wasn't perfect, but it was proof that I could do it if I kept trying and didn't give up.

That same year after Rebirth made it to Steam, I created another game called Restoration about two siblings on a journey to save people's fleeting hearts from turning into nightmares and honor their grandma's dying wish. Then a year after that, I created Luvocious. It's, it's own unique game, allowing you to play out the lives of four different characters from four completely different worlds. One of those worlds was Alcornagia, the world in which Solenars Edge Rebirth takes place in. Within this world, you take control of Princess Yuki, trying to regain her Kingdom from the murderous empire who took it from her. This story takes place about 30 years before Rebirth and about 10 after Balthus Requiem. I was now interconnecting my games and expanding on the story.

About 5-6 months after that, I rebooted Solenars Edge Legends into Solenars Edge Heroes and put it on Steam. Some people liked it more than Solenars Edge Rebirth even though it didn't have story. But, to each their own.

Shortly after that, I helped publish a guy named Anima and he had made Fesnia. My roaster of games was growing, but my motivation was not. The sales were less than favorable and the community was harsh. I didn't expect much going in, to be honest. But I did expect to be treated a bit better. But, sometimes you can't have your cake and eat it too.

After this long period of a break. In 2018, I started work on Falnarion Tactics back in August. I entered it in a contest thing on Itch.io. Everything seemed fine at first, I even placed higher than I expected. Sadly, I came under fire and things with south. Long story short, things were debunked and it was all just attention grabbing nonsense. It was really hard to deal with especially since I was already in a rut. But, regardless, I kept going. I made Estellium Legends and then Anima made Deatherem. They weren't quite received well, but Estellium Legends was pretty fun to play with me and my friends, I'll admit.

Sadly, shortly after this, Anima split. He allowed me the rights to his games though and I really haven't seen him ever since. I've then months later, created Falnarion Tactics II as I really enjoyed the first one and some people did too. It stuck out from my other games in a unique way and I was proud of that. Anyways, a new friend comes along and wants to make a fan game to the series. She joins me in person and creates Tales of Beasteria, she also had created a lewd puzzle game. But the Tales of Beasteria was a continuation of Falnarion Tactics, but just a fan based, not cannon game where you play as the bad guys. That was kind of cool. So, for a bit, it was me and her. Then Jaded Lancer joined and he brought his game; L'Cestrue Seyuntres to the table and Pluumpu merged her games; Tales of Beasteria and Hentai Slide Girl Puzzle (Or something).

Sadly, this year, Pluompu passed away due to COVID-19 and all her current and future projects were abandoned. It makes me sad still thinking about it, and it's really tragic. Now, today. I'm working on the conclusion of my years of hard work and the finale to the connection of all these games I've ever made. You may take a quick glance at these games, you may even play them and think they aren't anything special. But, please, know that I put years of hard work and effort and tried my best on a virtually non-existent budget.

With Jaded Lancer's game in early access and Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn around the corner. I really hope that if you made it this far in reading this, that you play the demo and enjoy it if you can. If you can't enjoy it, please offer me your feedback, so that changes my happen.

Thank you so very much for listening to my story. It's been a very long journey and the conclusion is just around the corner. Please look forward to Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn on June 18th 2020.

-Team Syukino.





*Side note:

 The Legend of The White Fang would later be renamed to Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn *This game*.

-Mining is now in the Mini-Game guide and has been in the game.

-The End Game Resort allows you to carry all your progress over into the resort or
start fresh with no Items, Weapons, Armor etc for a challenge.

-Cooking is now in the game with a new area within Nelditus Academy.
The kitchen is near the cafeteria. You may use some fishing materials as cooking
materials and new items such as an Apple, Meat and Egg have been added into
the game as well as some dishes you can cook.

-You can now wash your hands in some sinks throughout the game.

-The Rose of Abilities from Solenars Edge Rebirth makes it's return and is only available
through the Casino Coin rewards.

-Armeida Tactics may have to be released as DLC, but FREE DLC at that for it to work
correctly. Also, for those not interested in it, won't have to download it, to save DL time
due to the file size.

That is all for now. Please look forward to Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn.
Coming Soon.

notes.title: Important Info
notes.content:

It's about a month before the release of Solenars Edge II. Here are some important things you should know about.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn is complete.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]
Admittedly, I'm going to need to do a bit more testing to make sure everything is in working order.
The game will be released on schedule and might be pushed forward a bit. For those of you who
play/ have played the demo. Feedback is critical at this time. Any questions/concerns and anything you might want to see in the game. Now is the time to tell me within the discussion forums. I have time until
the release to at least hear you out. But, the less vocal you are, the more likely nothing will change.

Keep in mind that Chapter:0 is dark. Due to the setting, you may want to turn your brightness up.
The entire game is mostly sunny and clearly visible. I, personally have no issue, but I understand that
some may.

In battle, the character whose turn it is will light up and glow and there are turn indicators and glowing
lights on the map to help you through those dark times. But rest assured that most of the game is
actually bright, it's just mainly the start.


If you think of a cool idea for a skill, or a monster or some sort of quest that can be added in.
Please feel free to let me know what you think can be done to help improve the overall product
before release. I'll let you know if it's possible to be done.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II Demo out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/c55b02060585168213c285a134fae82f2045ec43.png[/img]
Play as Thedo from the first Solenars Edge in the Prologue chapter. Pay your respects to the fallen and fight a dangerous returning threat.


Demo features:

-1 Normal Battle.

-1 Boss Battle.

-1 Secret Boss.

-Three characters to play as.

-Lots of hidden goodies to find.

-The entire prologue chapter that is within the full game.

>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>========<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<

The full game features:

-A ton of normal battles through events, on-field encounters and very little random encounters
in some areas.

-Over 16 secret bosses each with their own battle theme. (Shaminguin was added in recently).

-Multiple fun Mini-Games to play.

-Multiple areas to explore and backtrack to. With a world map in Alcornagia.

-A ton of characters to switch between in and out of combat. *But never having too huge of a party at
one time.*

-Lots of Items, Weapons, Armors, Abilities, ETC to utilize.

-Hours of optional content that enhances game-play and makes the main story more enjoyable. 

-A ton of outfits for you to find and unlock to customize Aionis as you see fit.

-No Save Points *Except the one at the start.* (Save anywhere, anytime).

-Lots of dialogue and hours of story.

Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn is coming soon!

notes.title: The Endgame Resort will return.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]

The Endgame Resort is featured at the end of Solenars Edge Rebirth as a reward for players who finish the game. It will return in Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn. Of course, it will look very different and offer similar, yet completely different things. In the coming updates after launch, the Endgame Resort will receive new things, some of which you can influence by participating in the discussion forums.

The current status of the game is that it is about 80 percent complete.

chunk of 5 has already been worked on).

notes.title: You will not need to play other games in the series before SEII.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png[/img]

Although playing the other games in the series will provide a lot more backstory and character, world and etc development. There isn't a need to play any of them as Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn will have a good grasp on the story and will sum up the events of the other games without the need to play them. Allowing the player to jump in blind. For those who have played the other games such as Rebirth and Luvocious. There will be special references and hidden meanings you will understand.

Stay safe everyone.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn
notes.content: Sadly, Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn will be delayed as it will need more time. It will also be entered in an upcoming game jam on steam. Due to the recent events with Ploumpu, I'll need more time to finish this game. As far as the book is concerned. Chapters 0-8 are finished. Chapters 9-15 need to still be made. So in game terms; Chapters 0-3 are finished and chapters 4-5 or 6 need to be worked on and finished. I apologize for this delay, but given recent events it cannot be helped. I hope you understand.
